title: Graduate Success — WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology — Kathmandu University affiliated BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs in Jhapa, Nepal.

blocks.h1: Prepared for work, study, and leadership
paras: WCBT supports graduate success through practical learning, mentoring, industry exposure, and career preparation.

blocks.heading: What success looks like
paras: Graduate success is not a single destination. Students prepare for employment, entrepreneurship, teaching, training, and further study.

groups.title: Employment Readiness
text: Students build technical, communication, project, and workplace-readiness skills.

groups.title: Further Study
text: KU-aligned academic preparation supports students considering graduate programs.

groups.title: Entrepreneurship
text: Project work and innovation activities encourage students to explore startup thinking.

groups.title: Professional Network
text: Events, mentors, internships, and partnerships help students build useful connections.

groups.title: Confidence & Leadership
text: Students gain confidence through presentations, teamwork, activities, and practical work.

blocks.heading: Build your success story
paras: Explore programs and placement support designed for long-term growth.
